turns.text:
The protein half-life of **ALB** (albumin) cannot be determined using the Human Protein Atlas, as the database does not measure, track, or include protein half-life data. 

*(Note: In general physiological and biochemical literature, human serum albumin has a well-known circulating half-life of approximately 19 to 21 days, but this metric is not cataloged in the Human Protein Atlas.)*
